_metadata.source: Real project analysis (Phase 7) + UE 5.0-5.6 breaking changes
_metadata.changelog: v4.3.1: Removed 6 patterns - Delegate_DECLARE_Missing (90% FP) + PCH_Include_Order (100% FP) + Missing_CoreMinimal_Include (100% FP) + Missing_Category_UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION (100% FP - pattern checks outside parentheses) + EditAnywhere_Without_Blueprint (100% FP)

FAssetData.description: UE 5.6: FAssetData changed from 'class' to 'struct' (AnimNotify include removal side-effect)

AnimNotify_Include_Removed.description: UE 5.6: AnimNotify includes reorganized - may cause indirect type changes (e.g., FAssetData)

FGameplayTag_FORCEINLINE_Removed.description: UE 5.4: FORCEINLINE removed from FGameplayTag functions

UBlueprintFunctionLibrary_Deprecated.description: UE 5.3: BlueprintPure and BlueprintCallable together is redundant (BlueprintPure implies BlueprintCallable)

deprecated_UMETA_DisplayName.description: UE 5.1: Consider using UMETA(DisplayName="...") with quotes for clarity

StaticMesh_LoadObject_Deprecated.description: UE 5.0: LoadObject<UStaticMesh> is slow and discouraged - prefer LoadAsset or AssetRegistry

FVector_Add_Deprecated.description: UE 5.2: Consider using += operator instead of .Add() for FVector (more idiomatic)

UInputTriggerTimedBase_Missing_MinimalAP.description: UE 5.6: UInputTriggerTimedBase missing ENHANCEDINPUT_API causing link errors

Constexpr_Delegate_BuildMask.description: UE 5.6: MSVC 14.38 C++20 constexpr compatibility issue with delegate BuildMask

SharedPCH_InclOrderUnreal5_3.description: UE 5.6: Include order violation in SharedPCH (Unreal5_3 ordering)

UFUNCTION_Unsupported_Reference_Return.description: UFUNCTION with BlueprintCallable/BlueprintPure should not return references (Blueprint limitation)

FText_Deprecated_FromString.description: UE 5.0: FText::FromString() discouraged - prefer LOCTEXT/NSLOCTEXT for localization

TArray_AddUnique_Performance.description: TArray::AddUnique() is O(n) - consider TSet for frequent uniqueness checks

UObject_Constructor_Warning.description: CreateDefaultSubobject should only be called in constructor with FObjectInitializer

Deprecated_NewObject.description: UE 5.0: NewObject<> discouraged outside special cases - prefer ConstructObject or Spawn

FName_Comparison_Performance.description: Comparing FName with FString is inefficient - convert FString to FName first

GEngine_Null_Check.description: GEngine can be null - add null check before usage

UPROPERTY_Config_Without_ConfigFile.description: UPROPERTY with Config requires UCLASS with Config specifier

BlueprintReadWrite_Private.description: UPROPERTY with BlueprintReadWrite in private section - Blueprints cannot access

GENERATED_BODY_Missing.description: UCLASS/USTRUCT must have GENERATED_BODY() or GENERATED_UCLASS_BODY()

WorldContext_Without_Meta.description: WorldContext parameter requires meta=(WorldContext="WorldContext") for BlueprintCallable static functions

TWeakObjectPtr_UObject_Check.description: TWeakObjectPtr should check IsValid() or use Get() before dereferencing

Enum_BlueprintType_Missing.description: UENUM without BlueprintType - cannot be used in Blueprints
